title: Waves Mark
statement: Implement `solve(names)`. Each name is a test id. Names containing the substring `integration` go to the integration list. The rest go to fast. Return `{"fast": [...], "integration": [...]}` in input order.
constraints: A name can land in only one list

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A mark lets CI run the fast suite by default and the integration suite later.

editorial: A mark lets CI run the fast suite by default and the integration suite later. The split is the selection the mark expresses. A test whose name includes the word is the stand-in for a mark in this sandbox.
